source_claim: The official Denonbu CAST & STAFF page lists all 13 campaign characters in its credited cast, grouped under the project's schools/areas. Bandai Namco Entertainment is credited as the project's original concept and work, and the project describes itself as a music-original character project.
notes: The official Denonbu CAST & STAFF page groups these campaign members in its cast roster and credits Bandai Namco Entertainment for the original concept/work: https://adm-season2.denonbu.jp/caststaff/. It lists 大神纏, 東雲和音, 茅野ふたば, 桜乃美々兎, 水上雛, 犬吠埼紫杏, 黒鉄たま, 白金煌, 灰島銀華, 鳳凰火凛, 瀬戸海月, 大賀ルキア, and りむる (Reml). Bandai Namco Entertainment describes Denonbu as its music-original character project: https://www.bandainamcoent.co.jp/license/detail9/. The official Denonbu/ReML page describes the reml campaign member as the character りむる in the Denonbu project: https://denonbu.jp/reml. All 13 exact campaign tags are covered; the relations use the in-catalog Copyright root denonbu, whose exact family/root identity is already reviewed in Issue #180.
